Scholarships for International Undergraduate Students

Trinity offers a number of undergraduate scholarships for international students. These scholarships are awarded to acknowledge the highest achieving students and to assist international students of limited means. Many scholarships are made possible by bequests and gifts that have been generously donated to Trinity over the years. Full scholarship information is available below:

Global Excellence Undergraduate Scholarships Brazil Fundacao Estudar Scholarship Program Claddagh Undergraduate Scholarship (China) China Undergraduate Scholarship (Dr Jonathan KS Chiu and Dr Margaret Sau-Sheung Ip) E3 Balanced Solutions for a Better World Scholarship Foundation Scholarship (Continuing Students Only) Scholarships for Japanese Students Sport Scholarships University of Sanctuary Scholarships
